name: anudeep-khadi-bandar-billing
description: fix(whatsapp): persistent multi-session connection state, instant reload restoration, and Supabase cloud relay syncing
releaseNotes: 1. Fixed WhatsApp disconnect on browser close & reopen: Caches connected state in localStorage and hydrates instantly on launch. 2. Real-time Supabase settings listener updates WhatsApp dot/status across remote and mobile devices without manual polling. 3. Periodic server keep-alive refreshes cloud connection timestamps. 4. Zero-loss session restoration guarantees bot remains always-connected.
